_max_skipped_why: Skips allowed before gate 3 refuses. Raised 0 -> 2 on 2026-09-08, deliberately, with the reasons: (1) nul_truncation SKIPs on this laptop because the engine returns no document — no pipeline runs under the laptop engine today (mechanism not established; see thread_settings_matched); it used to XFAIL vacuously on that empty response; (2) engine_pid_not_name SKIPs because the harness's port-bound lookup (:5565) resolves a foreign engine while the benchmark's engine serves on the port in logs/engine.port. Both name their reason in the runner output. A SKIP is a path the suite did not run; a green run on fewer paths is a narrower claim (register entry 27), so more skips than this refuse — raise it deliberately, never by re-running until it passes; lower it back to 0 when the laptop engine runs pipelines again.
